list.name: vin
list.label: VIN
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vin AS __text, vin AS __value FROM telemetry ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT model AS "Model", model_year AS "Year", motor_config AS "Motor", has_heat_pump AS "Heat Pump", has_air_suspension AS "Air Suspension" FROM detect_vehicle_from_vin('$vin')

panels.title: Decoded VIN: $vin
panels.description: Vehicle information decoded from the selected VIN using the detect_vehicle_from_vin() database function.

panels.title: Fields seen in last 24h

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT field) AS fields FROM telemetry WHERE vin='$vin' AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

panels.description: Count of distinct telemetry fields received in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Total samples (24h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS samples FROM telemetry WHERE vin='$vin' AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

panels.description: Total number of telemetry samples stored in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Coverage by category

targets.rawSql: SELECT fc.category, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.field IS NOT NULL) AS seen, COUNT(*) AS total FROM field_catalog fc LEFT JOIN telemetry_latest t ON t.vin='$vin' AND t.field=fc.field GROUP BY fc.category ORDER BY 1

panels.description: How many fields in each category have been seen vs. catalogued.

panels.title: Charging

targets.rawSql: SELECT fc.field, fc.type, t.num_value AS value_num, t.str_value AS value_str, t.ts AS updated, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - t.ts))/3600, 1) AS age_hours, fc.description FROM field_catalog fc LEFT JOIN telemetry_latest t ON t.vin='$vin' AND t.field=fc.field WHERE fc.category = 'Charging' AND fc.field LIKE '$field_filter' ORDER BY fc.field

panels.description: Detailed table of all Charging category fields with latest values.
